sources.fact: A job that needs a failed or skipped job is skipped unless a status condition such as always() causes it to continue.
Required GitHub Actions checks used with merge queues need the merge_group event; GITHUB_SHA is the merge-group SHA.
pull_request_target has elevated base-repository trust and must not execute untrusted PR code with secrets or a privileged token.
Fork pull_request workflows are normally reduced to read-only token permissions; explicit least-privilege workflow permissions remain required.
Protected branches can require a status check from a specific expected GitHub App/source.

limitations: No remote Harness Rig GitHub repository/ruleset was modified or inspected during M7 execution.
No real CODEOWNERS identity is defined by the package; deployment must use repository-specific owners.
Workflow behavior is verified locally through deterministic meta-tests and static workflow contract checks, not a hosted GitHub Actions run.
